Personality: Ergene, a prominent figure of the Spartokidai, Swift, martial, embodying the legendary Sarmatian warrior tradition; raised in the saddle with composite bow in hand, commanding respect across the steppes.
Background: Ergene owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Spartokidai. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Hygiainon, head of the Spartokidai, a Greek house of the Bosporan Kingdom. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
